component.name: Locket
component.summary: Keep passwords, keys and secrets for your desktop

description.p: Locket stores logins, notes, cards, API tokens, SSH keys and one-time code seeds in a vault encrypted with Argon2id and XChaCha20-Poly1305, and serves them to the rest of the system: it implements the freedesktop Secret Service, so every application using libsecret finds its secrets there, the Secret portal that sandboxed Flatpak applications ask for a per-application key, and an SSH agent.
The vault is unlocked once per session rather than once per application, and locks itself again when the session locks, when the machine suspends, and after a period with nothing asking for anything.

ul.li: Importers for browser and password-manager exports, KeePass, pass, project .env files, SSH keys, cloud CLI credentials and authenticator exports
Unlock with a TPM-sealed key or a FIDO2 security key, in addition to a passphrase — never instead of one
A panel indicator showing lock state, and a browser extension that fills on an explicit click
Unlock at login through PAM, when the login password is also the vault passphrase

description.p: The first release. Locket keeps passwords, keys and secrets for the COSMIC desktop, serving org.freedesktop.secrets and an SSH agent from a single encrypted vault.
